title: Stamp trace.proof = "unrecorded" when a cap carries no real proof
action: In capCell, after the ENTIRE refusal chain has run (post cells.mjs:2178) and only for a cap that is about to succeed, stamp a new cell trace field trace.proof = "unrecorded" when NEITHER real verify output NOR verification_evidence was supplied (per D14). Treat output that is missing, null, empty, or whitespace-only as absent; a one-line real output counts as present. Never set the local feature_verify_pending flag to reach this — that variable (cells.mjs:1885) short-circuits six refusal sites (:1886-1899, :1912, :1999, :2032, :2135, :2164) and reusing it would void D2 and D6 (per D12). A cell holding verification_evidence is never stamped, even with empty verify_output, because a tiny-lane security cell whose 80-char red_failure_evidence already passed :2135 holds the strongest proof in the system (per D14). Exempt repos whose commands.verify is the string "none" — the noTestWaiver path at cells.mjs:1908 has no verify output by construction, so marking it would arm a close-door such a repo can never satisfy (per D12). Leave trace.feature_verify semantics completely untouched. This cell is high-risk lane, so it owns its own red-first proof: write the failing tests first, in packages/bee/tests/test_cells.mjs, following the table-driven fixture shape at test_cells.mjs:2189-2239 (cases array plus a for..of loop over the makeCell/claimCell/recordVerify/capCell pipeline). Required rows: output absent, null, empty string, whitespace-only all stamp; a one-line real output does not; verification_evidence present with empty output does not; an explicit --feature-verify-pending cap sets feature_verify and leaves trace.proof untouched; a commands.verify "none" repo is never stamped. Add a negative-control row proving an "unrecorded" cell still dies at the red-first door (:2135) when it is security/migration or high-risk lane.

truths: A cap with no verify output and no verification_evidence records trace.proof === "unrecorded"
A cap with a one-line real verify output does not record trace.proof
A cap with verification_evidence and empty verify output does not record trace.proof
An explicit --feature-verify-pending cap still sets trace.feature_verify === "pending" and leaves trace.proof unset
A repo whose commands.verify is "none" is never stamped
An "unrecorded" cell in a red-first tier still refuses without red_failure_evidence

trace.outcome: capCell stamps trace.proof="unrecorded" post-refusal-chain when neither real verify output nor verification_evidence was supplied (D10/D12/D14) — a new inert field, never the feature_verify pending flag; pending path and commands.verify:"none" repos exempt. 5 red-first rows + a 3-row negative control prove the marker buys no door bypass.

I ran them as development iterations and capped through --feature-verify-pending; the two instructions should be reconciled for red-first cells.
